objective: Reject proven nonzero finite images before ordinary cyclotomic exact-polynomial zero search, preserving every exact fallback and all existing native outputs.
output_contract: All four full original sphere cold/warm/replay transcripts must be byte-identical to the independently validated deterministic-selection parent. No changed rows, output sizes, certainty or checksums are allowed for this optimization.
proof_rule: The existing finite-field homomorphism maps an exact zero to zero whenever its operations are available. Only a nonzero root image rejects the zero attempt. Zero, unsupported images, nonunit denominators, invalid root indexes, expression limits and image-work exhaustion never certify anything and leave a fresh MAX_WORK exact reduction available.
cache_rule: No refinement, retained representation rewrite, persistent memo or cache publication is added. The new root image reads only the already constructed immutable local Plan.
tests: Reuse all twelve existing cyclotomic tests, including captured native zeros, perturbations, budget/abort/representation/concurrent replay and all 64 finite-field tables. Add two focused tests for root rejection guards and end-to-end modular collision/nonunit fallback with unchanged approximation caches.
measurement_scope: Feasibility only. Diagnostic command duration does not establish performance. Separate fixed costs are required before retaining an optimization.
